ai_review.summary: Excellent front‑of‑house soundboard capture (as good as FOB can get) despite the odd missing mic for Brent, delivering an overall stellar show.
ai_review.review: The reviewer rates both the set list and the sound a perfect five stars, calling this version “as good as F O B can get.” The front‑of‑house recording is praised for its clarity, though it’s noted that Brent’s microphone was inexplicably absent, eliminating his background vocals. Overall enthusiasm is very high, suggesting a high‑energy performance that won’t disappoint first‑time listeners.

ai_rating.rationale: Single enthusiastic review rates both show and recording at the top level; strong praise leads to a high rating, but confidence is low due to only one data point.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp front‑of‑house mix described as 'as good as F O B can get'; the only drawback mentioned is the missing microphone for Brent, resulting in absent background vocals.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set list praised with a full five‑star rating; no specific flow comments provided.

band_member_comments.Keys: No microphone was set up for Brent on this night, so his background vocals are missing.
